summary: Google Merchant Center integration fully tested. All 19 backend tests passed. Feed endpoint /api/merchant/feed.xml returns valid RSS 2.0 XML with Google Shopping namespace containing 1200 products. All products have required fields (g:id, g:title, g:description, g:link, g:image_link, g:price, g:availability, g:condition, g:brand), unique IDs, non-zero prices in 'XX EUR' format, correct google_product_category, shipping info with free e-ticket delivery, and custom labels. Frontend resale disclosure visible on landing pages. robots.txt updated to allow merchant feed.
critical_code_review_comments: Added Allow: /api/merchant/feed.xml to backend API robots.txt for consistency with frontend public/robots.txt
seed_data_creation: 1200 products from seo_pages collection with active=True and price_low > 0
context_for_next_testing_agent: Google Merchant Center feed fully functional. Key findings: 1) /api/merchant/feed.xml returns valid RSS 2.0 XML with xmlns:g namespace. 2) Feed contains 1200 products (387 F1, 269 football, 446 concert, 28 worldcup). 3) All products have unique IDs (slug-based), non-zero prices in 'XX EUR' format, correct google_product_category for event tickets. 4) Products include shipping (free e-ticket), custom_labels (category, city, price tier, year), identifier_exists=false. 5) /api/merchant/feed-status returns feed stats. 6) Frontend resale disclosure shows 'Independent resale marketplace' with data-testid='resale-disclosure'. 7) robots.txt allows /api/merchant/feed.xml.
